direction: Establish a baseline run of the static parallel-merge construction using score_merge_static, measuring the score and runtime under the 500 ms budget before exploring parameter or merge-order variations.

operations.mechanism: No archive feedback or previous-round summary is available, so the safest first step is to evaluate the only allowed template with its specified static merge scoring and no postprocessing. This creates a controlled baseline that can guide later changes in merge priority, parallelism, or scoring weights.
